answer: A beacon announces 100 entry slots each epoch, and an admission auction fills them. Applicants bid copper tokens; the top 100 win, losers are refunded, and each winner's bid locks as a bond under an umber seal. Forging 1,000 fakes means outbidding honest agents 1,000 times: at a 40-token clearing price that costs 40,000 tokens, over a year of honest earnings. Honest agents pay once, keep their slot, and earn while fakes bleed copper on every bid.
